name: Mesaj — Kreyòl texting helper
description: Understand English text messages and slang in Haitian Creole, and write replies back in English.
_comment_share_target: An installed PWA appears in the Android share sheet just like a native app. This gives back the share route without an APK. It does not help with Google Messages, which keeps Forward in-app, but it works anywhere that exposes a real system share.
